name: hbm_sfu_programme_store_r10_cl

pin_regs.reason: the r10 head registers every host input at the pin (p_* pin flops, 2-flop reset sync) and every output is a leaf output register or a head status register; a kit flop stage would add an edge to the priced r7c schedule (D=4)

structural_change: r10 parent (SFU-PS-2 10-17): 11 identical one-stripe leaves (hbm_sfu_store_stripe_r10_1017) + the thin head in ONE cluster, 3 cols x 4 rows with the head in the centre cell (c1,r1) so every leaf<->head leg is <= ~1 col + 1.5 rows. Rows (S->N), SFU-PS-3 re-plan: P2 P1 P0 | P6 head IO0 | P7 IO2 IO1 | P5 P4 P3, every leaf R0 (an MY leaf puts 836 pins off the M3/M5 tracks: no on-track origin); config chains are neighbour hops (P0>P1>P2, P3>P4>P5, IO1>IO2 westward in a row: leaf out W half -> next leaf in E half ~190 um; P6>P7 and IO0>IO1 one row up ~370 um); all three IO leaves touch the head cell. Columns x = 43.2 / 388.8 / 734.4 on the 43.2 lattice (coordinator 10-17: off-lattice 0.432 sub-lattice REJECTED). 950.4 = 22 x 43.2 does NOT fit: leaf w 285.12 = 6.6 x 43.2, so a 20-um channel forces a column pitch of 8 x 43.2 = 345.6 and 43.2 + 2 x 345.6 + 285.12 + 22.16 = 1041.7 > 950.4 (pitch 7 x 43.2 leaves 17.28-um channels and a 15.1-um E pin-face margin: gen FAIL channel/macro_edge). Smallest lattice-legal outline 1080 (25 x 43.2) x 950.4: 60.48-um channels, W margin 43.2, E margin 60.48 (host pin face). H-DIE slot 1080 x 950.4 pending coordinator review (requested 950.4^2), rows y = 43.2 / 259.2 / 475.2 / 691.2 (43.2 lattice, 21.6 um channels). Outputs (io_word 471 + compiler_control 1,742 + status) leave on the S face toward sfucore (2.4 pins/um), host config/start on the E face beside the head row, clock on the S face. Square-ish (1.08 x 0.95 mm) instead of 4x3 (1.23 x 0.69) to shrink the head radius (see lanes/SFU-PS-FUND.md: cross-leaf agreement paths). DECISION B (coordinator 10-17 ~20:40, SFU-PS-3): the r7c all-stripe agreement is no longer leaf->head->leaf combinational: each leaf's output gate in_cv = its OWN calendar_v & !fault (+ its own narrow-W check for P7/IO2), a local out->in loop at the leaf; the programme start is registered in the head (p_sv_q, +1 edge after IO2 bit 26; the compile schedule advances arith_start by 1 IO row, io_store_r10.hex). Every head path is now one registered leg: leaf status -> head flop (agreement/fault/status, <= ~690 um) and head flop -> leaf pin (start, <= ~890 um). RELAYS + CLOCK (SFU-PS-4, coordinator 10-17 0dh++++, after the decision-B gate ba12a358d measured a 1.8-2.1 ns clock spine, head->far leaf -770, leaf->head -777, leaf->S face -483 ps): (a) per-row programme launch relays (+1), (b) per-row configuration relays in front of chain heads P0/P3, (c) per-row registered status pre-combine before the head agreement/fault/status logic, (d) io_word/compiler_control re-registered toward the S face (+1). Store latency D=5, status 3 (r7c + 1 everywhere with ARITH_START_ADVANCE_R10=2 in io_store_r10.hex); lockstep vs r7c ISHIFT 1 / PSHIFT 3 PASS modes 0-4 + 4 seeds, mutants noshift/chain/flip/rowskew REJECTED. Clock: TritonCTS H-tree (clock=cts) with the leaves' liberty clock-tree-path insertion balanced against the cluster flops, instead of the one pre-placed spine.

job.purpose: SFU programme store r10 parent cluster with decision B head + SFU-PS-4 per-row relays (D=5), TritonCTS H-tree (11 one-stripe leaves + head, 3 cols x 4 rows, head centre). CRITICAL (hbm_sfu_programme_store): coordinator reviews the gate PNG before submit.
